title: Icon route
description: How a game's Icon Pack is built: where the item data comes from, where the pixels come from and which mapping module joins them. Optional in a game record.

game.description: The pack directory and the game identifier Takaro looks the pack up by.

data.description: Where the item codes come from: the pinned server depot, or files of this repository (the connector's own item list).

decoder.description: The decoder container that reads the code files.

files.description: Exact client-relative paths of the game code a mapper reads facts from (for example the game assembly).

code.description: Game code read from the installed client; it is mounted in the same read-only tree as the pixel files.

pixels.description: Where the pixels come from: an installed game client, or the same server depot the data comes from.

engine.description: The CUE4Parse EGame value that reads this game's containers.

aesKeyEnv.description: Name of the environment variable holding the containers' AES key; null for unencrypted games. Never the key itself.

unreal.description: Settings of the unreal decoder; required exactly when a role uses it.

alpha.description: How the decoded RGBA relates to alpha. straight: the colour channels are independent of alpha (a translucent pixel with a colour channel above its alpha cannot be premultiplied; the build reports the count).

xnb.description: Settings of the xnb decoder; required exactly when pixels.decoder is 'xnb'.

secrets.description: Names of environment variables the build reads; never their values.

decoder.description: A decoder container that reads the data files. Absent means an in-process parser.

input.description: The target's steam-depots input the data files come from.

depots.description: A subset of that input's depots; every depot of the input when absent.

files.description: DepotDownloader file-list selectors: an exact path, or regex: with a case-insensitive pattern.
Repo-relative paths of connector source files the item codes are read from; they are hashed and copied, nothing is downloaded.

input.description: The target's mojang-version input; its version manifest and server jar are the pins used.

decoder.description: The decoder container that runs the server jar's data generator.

reports.description: Data reports the generator must produce (for example registries.json).

downloads.description: Target revision to the pinned client jar of that release.

source.description: A key of the game record's sources.

access.description: files: the listed files are read whole. iostore-ranges: the listed .utoc files are read whole and only the .ucas byte ranges that hold the needed packages are copied.

files.description: Exact client-relative paths in precedence order (a name held by several is taken from the first listed), or regex: entries with a case-insensitive pattern matched against client-relative paths. With access iostore-ranges only .utoc paths; their .ucas files are derived.

clientBuilds.description: Target revision to the client build ids of the same release.

decoder.description: A decoder container that reads the pixel files; it must equal data.decoder, because both roles are decoded from the same mounted tree.

files.description: DepotDownloader file-list selectors for the pixel files, fetched with the data from data.input; same semantics as data.files.
